defs.def: work that is given by teachers for students to do at home （学生的）家庭作业

ex.s: I would feel completely at ease doing my homework in bed, with light music on.
ex.t: 我喜欢躺在床上做作业，放着轻音乐，感觉无比自在。

ex.s: Get up early to do my homework?
Unable to keep my eyes open, I decided I had no choice but to finish my homework the next morning.
ex.t: 我困得睁不开眼，于是决定别无选择，只能在第二天早上完成作业。

ex.s: They are tired of doing their homework.
ex.t: 他们厌倦了做家庭作业。

ex.s: I had done myself homework but I was shy.
ex.t: 我完成了自己的作业但我很害羞。

ex.s: And speaking of home, why aren't homework and housework the same thing?
ex.t: 说到家，为什么家庭作业和家务活不是同一回事？

ex.s: Next, write your homework in the new document.
ex.t: 接下来，在新文档中写下你的作业。

ex.s: Three days ago, to complete her homework quickly, she copied part of the article without thinking.
ex.t: 三天前，为了快速完成作业，她想都没想就抄了文章的一部分。

ex.s: Her teacher was very satisfied with her homework.
ex.t: 她的老师对她的作业非常满意。

ex.s: Then, the teacher wanted to enter her homework into a writing competition.
ex.t: 然后，老师想把她的作业提交到一个写作比赛中。

ex.s: Daily Work/In-Class Writings and Tests/Group Work/Homework (10%)
ex.t: 日常作业/课堂写作和测试/小组作业/家庭作业（10%）
